terms: All payments via bank draft or cheque in favour of 'Aerofront Developers', payable at par.
Additional car parking (beyond first allocation): Rs. 11,00,000 + GST per slot, subject to availability.
Additional DG power backup load: Rs. 30,000 per KVA + GST (meter & wiring extra, before possession).
Transfer charges: Rs. 300 per sq.ft + GST on super area per transfer (waived for direct registry from developer).
Interest + applicable GST charged on delayed payments per RERA guidelines.
PLC, GST, registration, stamp duty & statutory levies payable as per prevailing government regulations.
Home-loan approvals subject to bank policy; developer not responsible for sanction decisions.
Stated prices are escalation-free but subject to revision; applicable rate is the rate prevailing on the date of booking.
All areas are approximate, subject to final confirmation per sanctioned plans.
